topic: *205* caught drunk driving in one Cybera
hook: *205* caught drunk driving in one Cyberabad weekend
hook_b: Heading out this weekend in Gachibowli or Kondapur? Read this
tldr: Cyberabad police booked 205 drunk drivers in a weekend drive; courts sentenced 26 to jail.

beats.what: Cyberabad Traffic Police booked 205 motorists for drunk driving over one weekend.
beats.why: Weekend enforcement drives target drink driving across the Cyberabad commissionerate.
beats.care: Drunk driving here can mean jail, not just a fine. Book a cab after a party.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per Telangana Today: 205 motorists were booked in a weekend drive; 11 recorded high blood alcohol levels. Courts disposed of 289 cases, sentencing 26 offenders to imprisonment and fines, and penalising others. Exact jail terms and fine amounts were not in the summary.

cards.q: What would stop drunk driving fastest?

insight: 11 of the 205 had high blood alcohol levels; courts jailed 26 offenders.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Cyberabad Traffic Police book 205 motorists for drunk driving
